title: Attach to tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_execve and observe an exec
question: Can a program attach to the execve syscall tracepoint on this architecture and actually see an exec event?
pass_means: The native execve tracepoint exists, accepts attachment, and fires. Note this only covers native-width syscalls: on arm64, 32-bit compat processes take a different syscall path that this tracepoint does not see.
fail_means: Attachment failed or no event was observed for a process this probe itself executed.
